description: List shops that exemplify what to AVOID when looking for great espresso. Includes mass-market chains (Starbucks, Dunkin', Costa) and 'flavor-led specialty' shops that display third-wave signage but lean heavily on flavored drinks. Each entry shows why it's flagged. Useful as contrast when recommending real specialty cafes, and as regression fixtures for the scoring algorithm.
